SELECT u.id AS author_id, u.display_name, count(p.id) AS posts
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.author_id = u.id
WHERE u.tenant_id = ?
GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name

SELECT id, tenant_id, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at, version
FROM users
WHERE tenant_id = ? AND email = ?

UPDATE users
SET display_name = ?, version = version + 1
WHERE tenant_id = ? AND id = ? AND version = ?

SELECT id, display_name
FROM users
WHERE tenant_id = ? AND (? = '' OR display_name LIKE concat('%', ?, '%'))
ORDER BY id
LIMIT ?
